canonical_project: TWL-KOM Datacenter I and Datacenter II Ludwigshafen
notes: Official TWL-KOM pages list Datacenter I and certified TIER IV Datacenter II in Ludwigshafen. A 29 Jan 2025 company update says the Datacenter II expansion entered operation on 1 Dec 2024 and added about 1 MW of UPS-backed power plus 450 kW of cooling capacity for liquid-cooling/HPC demand.
